data.title: Advent Calendar Activity Cards Printable, 24 Days of Family Christmas Activities, Screen Free Kids Countdown
data.description:
Make December about moments, not more stuff. 24 simple family activities, one for each day until Christmas, with a fun question on every card to get everyone talking.
Most activities use what you already have at home, and 7 need nothing at all, so you can start tonight.

WHAT'S INCLUDED (13-page PDF)
- How to use page
- 24 cut-out activity cards, 4 per page, each with a Talk About It question
- 8 blank cards to add your own family traditions
- Countdown Tracker to mark each day and note what you loved
- Plan-Ahead Supply List matched to each day
- Our Family Memories page to keep with your decorations

ACTIVITIES INCLUDE
Write letters to Santa, a holiday lights drive, blanket fort night, bake and share cookies, call a grandparent, donate a toy, pajama picnic and more.

GOOD FOR
Kids ages 4 to 12, grandparents, homeschool and classroom countdowns.

DETAILS
- US Letter size, also prints on A4 (choose Fit to Page)
- Print on cardstock for sturdier cards
- Print as many copies as you need for your own family

HOW TO DOWNLOAD
This is a digital PDF download. Nothing will be shipped. After purchase, go to Purchases and Reviews in your Etsy account (or open the email from Etsy) and click Download Files. Print at home or at a local print shop.

For personal use only. Please do not resell or share the file.

data.title: Christmas Scavenger Hunt for Kids, 24 Rhyming Clue Cards, Christmas Morning Gift Hunt, Treasure Riddles
data.description:
Turn Christmas morning into a treasure hunt: kids follow clue cards from the tree to the fridge to the sock drawer until they find their gift. Every one of the 24 hiding spots comes in two levels, so little ones and big kids can hunt together.

What's inside (13 pages):
- How the Hunt Works page with setup steps and a sample 6-spot hunt
- Setup Sheet and Answer Key: all 24 spots with codes and an order column
- Little Elves Clues: 24 easy rhyming cards for early readers (about ages 4 to 7)
- Big Kid Riddles: 24 riddle cards for older kids (about ages 8 to 12)
- 6 blank Write Your Own Clue cards for spots only your home has
- 6 Final Gift cards to write where the present is waiting

Spots include the Christmas tree, stockings, refrigerator, couch cushions, bookshelf, a coat pocket, the bathtub and more. Use 6 spots for toddlers or all 24 for a long morning.

How it works:
This is a digital PDF download. Nothing ships. After purchase, download the file from your Etsy Purchases page or the email Etsy sends you, then print at home on cardstock and cut along the dashed lines. Prints on US Letter and fits A4 with "fit to page". For personal use.

data.title: Gingerbread House Contest Kit Printable, Decorating Contest Judge Score Cards, Voting Ballots, Award Certificates
data.description:
Run a gingerbread house contest that feels fair and fun: judges score every house on five criteria, guests vote People's Choice, and kids, teens and adults each get their own winners.

What's inside (15 pages):
- How to Run Your Contest: six steps plus the three age divisions
- Host Plan, supply checklist and party timeline
- Official Contest Rules (10 rules) with space for your house rules
- Team Sign-Up Sheet (14 teams)
- Team Build Plan with a sketch box and job list
- Judge Score Cards, 2 per page: Creativity, Structure, Decoration Detail, Neat Icing and Wow Factor, each scored 1 to 5
- Judging Guide explaining 1, 3 and 5 points, tie breakers and a sample scored card
- Results Tally Sheet for up to three judges
- People's Choice Ballots, 8 per page
- 12 award categories, from Grand Champion to Pretzel Architect

Great for family Christmas parties, classrooms, church groups and office holiday parties.

data.title: Letter from Santa Editable Printable, 6 Personalized Santa Letters, Nice List Certificate, North Pole Mail, Gift Tags
data.description:
Six letters from Santa for six different kinds of year, ready to type and print before Christmas Eve. Made for parents and grandparents of kids ages 2 to 9 who want a real North Pole letter without paying for a custom one or opening a Canva account.

Every letter is fully written and different. You type the child's name, the date, three good things they did this year and the P.S., then print. That is it.

WHAT'S INCLUDED (13 pages, US Letter, one editable PDF)
1. Cover with the full contents
2. How-to page: which letter fits which child, plus Christmas Eve delivery ideas
3. Letter 1, The Nice List: the classic letter for any child
4. Letter 2, Baby's First Christmas: a keepsake for a baby or toddler
5. Letter 3, New Big Sibling: for a child who became a big brother or sister this year
6. Letter 4, The Kindness Star: for a child who shared, helped or included others
7. Letter 5, A Hard Year, Done Well: for a move, a loss, an illness or a big change, handled bravely
8. Letter 6, A New Home: for a family that moved before Christmas
9. Official Nice List certificate with type-in name, elf note, signature and date
10. Santa's Nice List 2026: 14 type-in rows with "checked once" and "checked twice" tick boxes
11. Dear Santa wish list for the child: name, age, a kind thing they did, 6 wishes and a drawing box
12. 4 North Pole Express envelope labels with type-in name and address
13. 12 From Santa gift tags with type-in names
Plus a thank-you page at the end.

HOW EDITING WORKS
Open the PDF in the free Adobe Acrobat Reader on a computer (best), or the Adobe Acrobat Reader app on a phone or tablet. Click a pale green box and type. Sample words are already in every box, so you can keep them or type over them. No Canva account, no app sign-up, no waiting for an email. Fonts and colors are fixed so every page prints the way you see it. Other phone viewers may not show the type-in boxes.

PRINTING
Print at home at 100% on plain paper, or on cream or parchment cardstock for a real North Pole look. US Letter size; choose Fit to page for A4. Sign the letter in gold or red pen and seal it with a North Pole label.

THIS IS A DIGITAL DOWNLOAD
Nothing will be shipped. After you buy, go to You > Purchases on Etsy and tap Download Files. For personal use only.
